description: This PHP source file defines the ScreenPermissionDao class, which interacts with the database to retrieve screen permission entities based on specified module, action URL, and user roles. It extends a base DAO class and constructs queries using Doctrine's query builder to fetch relevant permissions from the database.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for ScreenPermission, providing methods to fetch permissions based on module, action URL, and user roles.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves an array of ScreenPermission entities filtered by module name, action URL, and roles, converting role objects or role names into a standard list of role names for query filtering.
